Definition: from G3550; to legislate, i.e. (passively) to have (the Mosaic) enactments injoined, be sanctioned (by them):--establish, receive the law.
BiblicalUsage: To receive the law is to live under it, and Hebrews says the people received the law under the Levitical priesthood — yet perfection did not come by it, so another priest must rise after the order of Melchisedec. The better covenant is established upon better promises, and the law given under Levi gives way to the ministry that is more excellent.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the law received under Levi was never the end: it prepared the way for the better covenant and the priest who lives forever.
